description.en: The device name of the gateway.

description.zh:
实例ID：
- 企业版实例：必须传入此参数。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看您的企业版实例ID。
- 公共实例：无需传入此参数。
description.en:
The instance ID:  
- Enterprise instance: You must specify this parameter. You can view your Enterprise instance ID on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.  
- Public instance: You do not need to specify this parameter.

description.zh: 网关所属产品的Key，产品的唯一标识符。
description.en: The ProductKey of the product to which the gateway belongs. This is the unique identifier of the product.

descriptions.zh:
## 限制条件
- 如果在企业版实例中调用该接口，必须传入参数**IotInstanceId**的值。否则，调用接口会失败。
- 单阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为20。
    > RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Conditions
- If you call this API in an Enterprise instance, you must specify the **IotInstanceId** parameter. Otherwise, the API call fails.
- The maximum queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account is 20 when calling this API.  
    > Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot disable-device-tunnel-share --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --product-key a1Wmy000000 --device-name LEGatewayAuto_B3XM000000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot DisableDeviceTunnelShare --region cn-hangzhou --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --ProductKey a1Wmy000000 --DeviceName LEGatewayAuto_B3XM000000
